title: Technology-Assisted-Analysis Record Composer
description: Compose a signed, structured record of a technology-assisted analysis performed with an AI/ATT tool, per PCAOB AS 1105 / AS 2301 as amended (SEC Release No. 34-100774). Internal-tool analyses reference a deterministic OCG receipt (observed); external-tool analyses are asserted with digests. Labeling differs visibly.

mcp_tool_definition.name: compose_technology_assisted_analysis_record
mcp_tool_definition.description: Compose a PCAOB AS 1105 / AS 2301 technology-assisted-analysis documentation record from the auditor's description of the analysis performed, labeling internal (observed) vs external (asserted) tool provenance distinctly.
